def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, IntVal, Solver, sat, And

    tun_info = Int('tun_info')
    tun_info_mode = Int('tun_info_mode')
    ip_tunnel_info_af = Int('ip_tunnel_info_af')

    IP_TUNNEL_INFO_TX = 1
    AF_INET = 2

    s = Solver()

    # Base script constraint
    s.add(tun_info == 0)

    # Constraint set 2 constraints
    s.add(tun_info != 0)
    # (tun_info_mode & IP_TUNNEL_INFO_TX) != 0  ->  bit 0 of tun_info_mode is set
    s.add(tun_info_mode % 2 == 1)
    s.add(ip_tunnel_info_af == AF_INET)

    return s.check() == sat
